m.d: If something is about to happen, it will happen very soon.
m.e: Please be seated. We're about to begin.

m.d: You use about to say what subject something is related to.
m.e: Let's not talk about her problems.

m.d: If something moves about, it moves in many directions.
m.e: He walked about the place, looking everywhere.

m.d: Having to do with, concerning, regarding.
m.e: I will talk about dogs.

m.d: If someone is able to do something, they can do it.
m.e: I'm busy tomorrow, so I won't be able to see you.

m.d: If a person is able, the person is good or skillful at what he does.
m.e: She is an able teacher.

m.d: If something is absolutely true, correct, etc., it's 100% so.
m.e: I agree. You're absolutely right.

m.d: If something is absolutely beautiful, brilliant, etc., it's very much so.
m.e: "It was wonderful," Martha said. "Absolutely wonderful! The best!"

m.d: You say there is absolutely nothing, to emphasise that there is nothing.
m.e: I have absolutely no idea why he said that.

m.d: If A is above B, A is higher than or before B, but not touching B.
m.e: In a newspaper, the title of a story is usually above the story.

m.d: The above comment, discussion, argument, etc. is one higher than or coming before something.
m.e: Please see the above discussion of the problem.

m.d: An ability is something that you can do.
m.e: I have a very good reading ability.

m.d: on or onto a boat, airplane, train, etc.
m.e: When everyone is aboard, the doors will close.

m.d: An absolute is something that will always exist.
m.e: Death is considered to be an absolute.

m.d: If something is absolute, it is complete or total.
m.e: The light went out and he was in absolute darkness.

m.d: Abuse is touching or acting towards someone in a way that will likely hurt them.
m.e: The girls suffered terrible physical and sexual abuse from their father.

m.d: An abuse is an act of using something in the wrong way.
If you abuse something, you misuse it; you use something improperly.
If you abuse something, you injure it; you hurt it; you treat it with cruelty or damage it.
If you abuse somebody, you rape them; you assault them.
Abandon is a state where you do not control yourself.
m.e: In these games, kids shoot and blow each other up with reckless abandon.

m.d: If you abandon something, you go away from it with no plan to return.
m.e: Many teens abandon all chances of a successful future when they drop out of school.

m.d: If you abandon something, you give up control of it.
m.e: They danced wildly down the street, abandoning themselves to the night and the moon.

m.d: If somebody goes abroad, they leave their home country and go to another country.
m.e: They sent their children to school abroad.

m.d: If somebody lives abroad, they live in another country.
m.e: She spent four years abroad before returning to Brazil.

m.d: Something absurd is ridiculous and stupid.
m.e: Saying that a fish cannot swim in water is just absurd.

m.d: Absence is when something is not there.
m.e: There was an absence of help for the project.

m.d: An absence is a time something is not there.
m.e: I failed the class because I had too many absences.

m.d: If a woman has an abortion, her pregnancy is ended deliberately.
m.e: She's had two abortions.

m.d: Abraham is a male given name.
Abraham was the founder of the Hebrew nation.
If someone has been abducted, that means they have been taken by someone without their permission.
Abigail is a female given name.
m.e: Abigail is working on a report.

m.d: When you absent yourself from something, you do not turn up for it and not appear.
m.e: John absented himself from the meeting as he had something on.

m.d: If something is absent, it means to be not in a place or missing.
m.e: John is absent from school today.

m.d: Absent means without or barring.
m.e: Absent any problems, we should be finished in two hours.

m.d: If you abort something, you stop something from happening any longer.
m.e: The space mission was aborted because there was a fuel leak.

m.d: If a doctor aborts an unborn baby, they stop it from being born alive.
m.e: The baby was aborted in pregnancy because it was a girl.

m.d: An abbey is a building where monks or nuns live, or used to live.
m.e: After working in the fields, the monks went back to the abbey.

m.d: An abbey is a church which was once part of an abbey.
m.e: Westminster Abbey is a famous church in England.

m.d: Abel is the son of Adam and Eve who was killed by his brother Cain.
Abel is a male given name.
Abduction is the act of taking someone away by force.
An abnormal thing, or situation, is one that is strange, or not typical.
m.e: The weather is abnormal in Europe when it is hot in winter.

m.d: When something is abnormal, it often means that it is bigger than [[normal].
m.e: The company made abnormal profits this year.

m.d: The abdomen is the front part of the lower torso containing many internal organs.
m.e: The stomach and intestines are inside the abdomen.

m.d: The abdomen is the last of the three parts of an insect's body.
If something is absorbed, it is sucked or soaked up (usually a liquid).
m.e: The sponge absorbed the spilled water.

m.d: If you absorb something, you take it in and use it; you learn it.
m.e: The teacher was good, I absorbed everything that she said.

m.d: If something absorbs your time, it takes all it up; it occupies all of your time.
m.e: The job absorbs all of my time during the busy season.

m.d: Abbott is a surname.
An abyss is a very deep crack in the earth.
If you can't abide something, you really do not like it.
If you abide by a rule or decision, you follow or accept it.
m.e: "You will face a life sentence in prison if you do not abide by my rule!" the king threatened.

m.d: If someone is absorbed, they are deep in thought; they are engrossed.
m.e: The student was very absorbed in his studies.

m.d: The act of abandoning.
m.e: The abandoning of the child happened 10 years ago.

m.d: An abbot is a man who is the leader of an abbey of monks or monastery.
Abbot is a surname.
Abdul is a male given name. Abdul means servant in Arabic which is derived from the word Abd.
If someone is abusive, he is violent and abuses (takes advantage of) others.
m.e: My father was abusive to us children. He always hit us when he was angry.

m.d: An abstract is a short text that tells you the main ideas of a longer text, especially of scientific papers; it is a summary of something longer.
m.e: The abstract of Isaac Newton's laws of gravity may be no more than 150 words.

m.d: An abstract is an abstraction; it is an abstract word.
An abstract is a piece of art that is made in the abstract fashion of art.
If you abstract something, you summarize it; you abridge it.
If you abstract something, you separate it; you remove it.
If you abstract something, you withdraw it.
If something is abstract, you cannot touch it, and it is difficult to imagine or think about.
m.e: A lot of abstract painting uses harsh shapes and most people do not like it.

m.d: If something is abstract, it is general.
If something is abstract, it is thought of as apart from any other use with an object; it is removed from it; it is separate or abstracted.
Relating to the abdominal muscles
m.e: The man has strong abdominal muscles.

m.d: If there is an abundance of something, then there is plenty of it.
m.e: Harry was pleasantly surprised by the abundance of food on the Thanksgiving table.

m.d: The ABC are the letters of the alphabet
The ABC of something is the most basic thing you have to know about it
ABC can mean "American Born Chinese"
An abomination is something very nasty or unpleasant.
in bed
m.e: Mary stays abed because she is ill.

m.d: If something happens abruptly, it happens without a warning. It is unexpected.
An abode is the place where you live.
m.e: We made our abode in a little old house by a stream.

m.d: If something is abundant, then there is a lot of it.
m.e: The abundant fruit trees provided a steady supply of food for the monkeys.

m.d: If you abduct a person, you take them away by force.
An abrupt action is one that is sudden, or not expected.
m.e: There was an abrupt change in the weather, and it started raining before we could get home.

m.d: An abrupt landscape is one with sudden steep changes.
m.e: We came to a halt because we could not pass the abrupt cliffs.

m.d: Abbas is a male given name.
If something is abominable, it is awful (horrible).
m.e: My mother thought that book I read was abominable.

m.d: If someone is abominable, they are not liked.
m.e: The students felt their teacher was abominable.

m.d: An abandonment is an action that causes someone or something to be abandoned.
To absolve someone is to free that person from a sin or from a promise.
m.e: The king absolved his servant of the oath.

m.d: Abstinence is when someone is abstaining from something or when someone does not take part in something.
m.e: Abstinence stops you from getting drunk.

m.d: Abdullah is a male given name.
Abracadabra is something that cannot be understood because it does not make sense.
m.e: The lunatic's book was complete abracadabra.

m.d: Abracadabra is a word you use during a magic trick.
When you abolish something, you end it by making it invalid or illegal. You usually use the word "abolish" in regard to laws or actions.
m.e: The censorship law was abolished due to huge opposition by many people.

m.d: If something or someone is ablaze, it is on fire; it is burning strongly.
m.e: After many tries, the camper finally looked down at the stack of wood that was now ablaze.

m.d: If something is ablaze, it is glowing with a bright light and color.
If something is ablaze, it is done very passionately.
If something is ablaze, it is done in a blaze; it is on fire.
m.e: Twitter was ablaze with tweets after Apple showed its' newest IPhone.

m.d: If you abet someone, you help them do something that is a crime.
An abrasion is a scraped spot or area.
